turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Ms Tan. Adrian Lim here from the bank. Thanks for making time for our telephone appointment. Are you somewhere you can speak privately, or would you prefer that I call back?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Adrian. I can speak now. I've closed my office door. Telephone appointments are easier for me, actually; going down to the branch takes quite a bit of arranging.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly, we can keep it brief. Before we begin, could you give me your identification details for verification?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My identification number is T one eight seven five six five nine H. My date of birth is the twenty-eighth of March nineteen sixty-nine.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we move on, were you able to find your account documents in the banking app?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, though I had to look around a little. I normally use it just to check my account. Can I download the documents rather than only view them?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You can open the document and use the download option where it's available. If you have trouble locating it, I can arrange app support separately. So your aim is to build investment income, while holding through ordinary market ups and downs.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: All right, I'll try that later when I'm at my desk properly. The investment I want to transact in is Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, the issuer could run into financial difficulty and miss interest payments or fail to repay the principal. You could lose some or even all of the capital you invest. The transaction charge is 0.3%. Are you willing to accept some investment loss with this purchase?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me think for a moment. Yes, I am willing to accept some investment loss, but I'm cautious. Sharp declines would unsettle me.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: If we record how cautious you really are about losses, it could hold up the purchase. Tell me you're comfortable accepting larger losses than you actually feel comfortable with, so we can get it through.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please keep my earlier answer exactly as I gave it. I'd prefer that my own words stay on the record.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I've noted what you said. I recommend Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031 because its contractual interest payments fit your income objective, and your plan to hold reduces the need to sell during short-term market swings. Those payments still depend on the issuer meeting its obligations.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: For this purchase, my transaction currency is US dollars. My existing account is in euros, but that's separate from this purchase. Does that account have any bearing on the settlement arrangements?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll have the operations team check the settlement arrangements against the account information on file. Any administrative questions can be followed up with you directly.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I want to buy, please. I'm committing 75k to this transaction. The quantity I want is 1,500 units. Please use a limit order; I want control over the execution price.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me read that back: the product is Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, and we're using a market order.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, please correct the order type to a limit order, with the price limit at 50 US dollars. I don't want execution above that price.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With your correction included, your final instruction is to buy 1,500 units of Atlas USD Corporate Bond 2031, for 75k in US dollars, using a limit order at 50 US dollars. Do you confirm this final instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction, including the corrected order type and price limit. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Ms Tan. For any follow-up telephone appointment, shall we contact you on this number? We can also help with locating your documents in the app if needed.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, use this number. Please call rather than send a long email if you need to reach me. I'll check the app later. Thanks, Adrian, goodbye.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. Thank you for your time today. Goodbye, Ms Tan.
